name: Vilabertran (Spain)
description: Blue field with the white cross of the arms, its arms ending in circles and charged with five red roundels, set towards the hoist.
history: The official flag of Vilabertran is blue with the white cross of the municipal arms charged with five red roundels of diameter 1/6 of the width, all tangent to the arcs forming the cross; the pale and arms of the cross reach the edges of the cloth and its vertical axis is displaced towards the hoist at a third of the length.

features.role: cross with rounded arm ends reaching the edges, its vertical axis at one third of the length
